user_problem: A report table contains footnote markers whose qualifiers may apply to one cell, a row, a column or the whole table; readers must not silently broaden the qualifier.
unique_output: A cell-level qualifier-scope map with exact marker/definition references, explicitly supplied inheritance rules, orphan markers and unresolved scopes.
required_input: Labeled table cells and headings, marker placements, supplied footnote definitions and any stated scope legend.
critical_rule: Apply only supplied scope rules. A marker location alone does not establish unstated inheritance; no qualifier is interpreted as proof of the underlying claim. Preserve ambiguous scopes and conflicting definitions.
nearest_existing_and_difference: reference-list-formatter formats references, pdf-extraction-and-forms extracts source content, document-template-field-map binds placeholders and claim-evidence-map checks entailment; this maps qualifier applicability within an already supplied table.
acceptance_scenario: Legend: a cell marker applies only to that cell. R1C1 contains Standard* and R1C2 contains Included. Definition *: delivery excluded. Output binds the exclusion only to R1C1; no supplied exclusion is inferred for R1C2.
